text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Turkish warplanes kill and injure 20 Iraqi civilians.
- Oil minister Amir Muhammad Rasheed says Iraq completed its partial oil exports under the oil-for-food deal with U.N.
- President Saddam Hussein orders the formation of a theatre committee in Iraq.
- Iraq complains about delays in approval of food and medical contracts under oil deal with U.N.
- Arab group at U.N. denounces Turkish invasion.
- Egyptian and Iraqi officials discuss Turkish invasion of northern Iraq.
- Iraqi ambassador in Turkey calls for the immediate withdrawal of Turkish troops from northern Iraq.
(The above were also carried by JUMHOURIA and AL-IRAQ)
- Editorial lambasts Washington and says America will never accomplish its dreams in Iraq.
- Article on aims behind the Turkish incursion into northern Iraq.
- Article on Arabs' national security in the thinking of Arab Baath party.
- France is ready to execute joint projects in Iraq.
- Editorial attacks United States and says failure will accompany its anti-Iraq plans.
- Nation-wide campaign to repair combine harvesters.
